zh-Hant.heading: 三週-從摺紙到結構
zh-Hant.body: 課程的每一週都增加一個層次。摺紙練習測試抽象，高線公園地圖把基地讀成地景與覆蓋，外部與內部的繪圖則開始了介入。Rhino 模型隨後把內部、玻璃、樓梯與外殼組成一個多孔結構，並以爆炸軸測圖、剖平面與一系列視角呈現。

pins.title: The Lonely Traveler
pins.description:
Crumpled paper, birdcage sketches and a cave drawing lead to a clay cave wrapped around a toy birdcage.

Physical model | Cave and birdcage study | Clay (mainly), toy birdcage | 10×9×12 inch | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 孤獨的旅人
zh-Hant.description:
揉皺的紙、鳥籠速寫與一張洞穴繪圖，發展出一座包覆玩具鳥籠的黏土洞穴。

實體模型｜洞穴與鳥籠研究｜黏土（為主）、玩具鳥籠｜10×9×12 英吋｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The project asked how the random, irregular form of a natural cave could be combined with the texture of a birdcage.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 專題探問天然洞穴隨機而不規則的形態，如何與鳥籠的紋理結合。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: A model of crumpled paper mimicked how natural caves are created randomly and irregularly. Sketches of different types of birdcages tried to adapt the curvy structure of a cave, and a concept drawing adapted the texture of birdcages on a cave.
captions: Inspiration: the crumpled paper model, birdcage sketches and the concept drawing.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 一件揉皺的紙模型模仿天然洞穴隨機而不規則的生成方式。不同類型的鳥籠速寫嘗試吸收洞穴的彎曲結構，一張概念圖則把鳥籠的紋理放到洞穴上。
captions: 靈感：揉紙模型、鳥籠速寫與概念圖。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The final model was shaped mainly in clay around a toy birdcage. Stairs wind between the openings.
captions: Details of the stairs and the birdcage.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 最終模型主要以黏土環繞一個玩具鳥籠塑形。樓梯在開口之間蜿蜒。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A pencil drawing shows the world inside the cave, filled with stairs and rooms.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 一張鉛筆畫呈現洞穴內部的世界，裡面充滿樓梯與房間。

sections.heading: Cave and Cage - A Hollow World
sections.body: The project joins two opposites, a cave formed by chance and a birdcage built by rule. Crumpled paper stood in for the irregular cave, sketches bent birdcages toward its curves, and a concept drawing laid the cage texture over the rock. The clay model wraps a toy birdcage in a hollow, stair-filled shell, and a final drawing imagines the world inside it.

zh-Hant.heading: 洞穴與鳥籠-中空的世界
zh-Hant.body: 這個專題把兩個對立物結合：一個偶然形成的洞穴，與一個依規則搭建的鳥籠。揉紙代表不規則的洞穴，速寫把鳥籠彎向洞穴的曲線，概念圖則把鳥籠紋理覆蓋到岩石上。黏土模型把玩具鳥籠包進一個中空、充滿樓梯的外殼，最後一張繪圖想像其中的世界。

pins.title: Weathering With You
pins.description:
Themes of power, loneliness, climate change, sacrifice and family from the film are built as layers of a tower.

3D art work | Film-to-space study | Blue paper, metal rod, cotton, wooden sticks, translucent coloured paper, mirrored paper | 1000×500×400 mm | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 天氣之子
zh-Hant.description:
電影中的力量、孤獨、氣候變遷、犧牲與家庭等主題，被建成一座塔的不同層次。

立體藝術作品｜電影轉譯空間研究｜藍色紙、金屬桿、棉花、木棒、半透明色紙、鏡面紙｜1000×500×400 毫米｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The film Weathering With You by Makoto Shinkai follows two teens finding love in rain-filled Tokyo who become tied to the mission of saving the city from flooding. The student set out to make a 3D model based on the story.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 新海誠的電影《天氣之子》講述兩位青少年在多雨的東京相戀，並捲入拯救城市免於水患的任務。學生決定以這個故事製作一件立體模型。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: After rewatching the film, the student outlined its structure and highlighted the themes of power, loneliness, climate change, sacrifice and family, then chose a towered design with multiple layers. Cinematic shots gathered on Pinterest helped design each layer.
captions: The concept sketch with reference film shots.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 重看電影後，學生整理故事結構，標出力量、孤獨、氣候變遷、犧牲與家庭等主題，並選擇多層的塔狀設計。從 Pinterest 收集的電影畫面協助設計每一層。
captions: 概念草圖與參考電影畫面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: The bottom and third layers show loneliness with a complex silhouette of a grayscale cityscape of Tokyo. The second layer represents power and family with a reflective geometric ball-shaped core, made of wooden sticks and translucent coloured paper with branched-out mirrored paper.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 底層與第三層以一座灰階東京城市的複雜剪影呈現孤獨。第二層以一顆反光的幾何球狀核心代表力量與家庭，以木棒與半透明色紙製成，再以分枝狀的鏡面紙重現「放射」元素。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: The fourth layer symbolizes the rain and the sacrifice of the female protagonist. Small blue paper squares are bound with a flexible metal rod into a water-tornado-like structure, topped with cotton clouds.
captions: The water tornado with cotton clouds.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 第四層象徵雨與女主角的犧牲。小塊藍色方紙以可彎曲的金屬桿綁成如水龍捲般的結構，頂端以棉花做成雲。

sections.heading: Layers of a Story - Rain over Tokyo
sections.body: The model turns a film into a stack of themes. A grayscale Tokyo silhouette holds the loneliness at the bottom, a reflective geometric core carries power and family, and a spiral of blue paper squares with cotton clouds rises at the top for the rain and the sacrifice. Each layer was designed with cinematic shots as reference.

zh-Hant.heading: 故事的層次-東京上空的雨
zh-Hant.body: 這件模型把一部電影轉為一疊主題。灰階的東京剪影在底部承載孤獨，反光的幾何核心承載力量與家庭，頂端則以藍色方紙與棉花雲的螺旋升起，代表雨與犧牲。每一層都以電影畫面為參考而設計。

admitted_schools.zh-Hant: 康乃爾大學建築本科 ED

pins.title: The Platform
pins.description:
A three-section clay tower turns the vertical prison of the film The Platform into a model about class, greed and food.

3D model | Film-to-space study | Clay, wire, wood sticks, acrylic paint | 28×35×55 cm | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 絕命大平台
zh-Hant.description:
一座三段式的黏土塔，把電影《絕命大平台》中的垂直監獄轉化為一件關於階級、貪婪與食物的模型。

立體模型｜電影轉譯空間研究｜黏土、鐵絲、木棒、壓克力顏料｜28×35×55 公分｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: In the film The Platform by Galder Gaztelu-Urrutia, a platform of food descends each day through a vertical concrete prison, feeding the upper levels first. The student wanted to build a model around its message of inequality.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 在 Galder Gaztelu-Urrutia 執導的電影《絕命大平台》中，一座滿載食物的平台每天穿過垂直的混凝土監獄下降，先餵飽上層的人。學生想圍繞電影中關於不平等的訊息製作一件模型。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: After thinking through the plot, the student designed a tower with three sections for the different classes in the film. The sketch notes a luxurious environment and greens as the upper-class symbol, a middle-class society, and decaying walls for the harsh environment of the lower class.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 思考劇情後，學生設計了一座三段式的塔，對應電影中的不同階級。草圖標示上層的奢華環境與象徵上層階級的綠植、中層社會，以及代表下層惡劣環境的腐朽牆面。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Greed, waste and revolt were key themes found on rewatching the film. They were built into the tower as dangerous spikes, distorted outlines and hanging stripes, shaped by hand in clay over wire.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 重看電影時，貪婪、浪費與反抗成為關鍵主題。它們以危險的尖刺、扭曲的輪廓與垂掛的條帶融入塔中，以黏土覆蓋鐵絲手工塑形。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Miniature food models in colourful clay stand out against the white tower, emphasizing the theme of food. A domed top rises over the upper level, and hanging stripes fall toward the base.
captions: Colourful food at the upper level.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 彩色黏土製成的迷你食物在白色塔身上格外醒目，強調食物的主題。穹頂升起在上層之上，垂掛的條帶則落向基座。

sections.heading: Three Levels - Food Falling Down
sections.body: The model reads the film's vertical prison as a tower of classes. A sketch set out luxury at the top, a middle-class level and decaying walls below, and spikes, distorted outlines and hanging stripes were added for greed, waste and revolt. Small food in bright clay marks what passes from level to level.

zh-Hant.heading: 三個層級-向下落的食物
zh-Hant.body: 這件模型把電影中的垂直監獄讀成一座階級之塔。草圖先安排頂部的奢華、中層與下方腐朽的牆面，再加入尖刺、扭曲輪廓與垂掛條帶，代表貪婪、浪費與反抗。鮮豔黏土做成的小食物，標示出在各層之間傳遞的東西。

admitted_schools.zh-Hant: 康乃爾大學建築本科 ED

pins.title: Chimera
pins.description:
iPad illustrations merge everyday objects with plants, animals and buildings into hybrid figures.

Illustration | Hybrid object study | iPad illustrations | 52.9×79.4 cm | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 奇美拉
zh-Hant.description:
iPad 插畫把日常物件與植物、動物及建築融合為混種形象。

插畫｜混種物件研究｜iPad 插畫｜52.9×79.4 公分｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The series asks what appears when two or more unrelated things are drawn as one.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個系列探問，當兩個或更多不相關的事物被畫成一體時，會出現什麼。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Each drawing pairs an old object with something living or built: a telephone with a herb, and a coffee grinder with the Monument to Nicholas I, a seahorse and chapels.
captions: Coffee grinder, Monument to Nicholas I, seahorse, chapels.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 每張圖都把一件舊物與生物或建築配對：電話與香草，以及咖啡磨豆機與尼古拉一世紀念碑、海馬與小教堂。
captions: 咖啡磨豆機、尼古拉一世紀念碑、海馬、小教堂。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A steel gate grows around a coffee grinder.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 一道鋼製大門環繞咖啡磨豆機生長。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A telephone merges with a pagurian, a kind of crab that lives in seashells.
captions: Telephone, pagurian (a kind of crab that lives in seashells).

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 一部電話與寄居蟹（一種住在貝殼裡的蟹）融合。
captions: 電話、寄居蟹（一種住在貝殼裡的蟹）。

sections.heading: Hybrids - Objects That Grow
sections.body: The four illustrations treat old objects as hosts. A telephone sprouts a herb, a coffee grinder carries a monument, chapels and a seahorse, a steel gate grows around another grinder, and a telephone becomes the shell of a crab. All are drawn in dense black line.

zh-Hant.heading: 混種-會生長的物件
zh-Hant.body: 四張插畫把舊物當作宿主。電話長出香草，咖啡磨豆機背負紀念碑、小教堂與海馬，鋼門圍繞另一台磨豆機生長，電話則成為寄居蟹的殼。全部以密集的黑色線條繪成。

pins.title: Guangzhou City
pins.description:
Daily sketches record Beijing Road and an aerial view of Liede in Guangzhou.

Drawing | Daily sketches | Sketch | 26.3×19.7 cm | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 廣州城市
zh-Hant.description:
日常速寫記錄廣州的北京路，以及獵德的鳥瞰景象。

繪圖｜日常速寫｜速寫｜26.3×19.7 公分｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The daily sketches record places in Guangzhou.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這組日常速寫記錄廣州的地方。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Beijing Road is drawn at street level, with shopfronts, signs, a bus and people at a junction.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 北京路以街道視角描繪，畫中有店面、招牌、一輛巴士與路口的行人。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: Liede is drawn from above, with blocks of buildings along the river and a bridge across it.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 獵德以鳥瞰角度描繪，畫中有沿河的建築群與一座跨河的橋。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: Both sketches use ink line with flat washes of colour.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 兩張速寫都以墨線搭配平塗色彩完成。

sections.heading: Two Views - Street and River
sections.body: The pair looks at the same city at two scales. Beijing Road is seen from the street among shops and traffic, while Liede is seen from the air as blocks beside the river. Both are drawn in ink line with flat colour.

zh-Hant.heading: 兩種視角-街道與河流
zh-Hant.body: 這兩張圖以兩種尺度觀看同一座城市。北京路從街道上看，置身店面與車流之間；獵德則從空中看，是河邊的一片片街廓。兩張都以墨線與平塗色彩繪成。

pins.title: My Insect Gallery
pins.description:
Close-up photographs show spiders, caterpillars, a locust, insect eggs, a white nymph and stinkbugs against a dark background.

Photography | Nature observation | Photographs | Student Project | Design Mentor: Yu Chun Tsai

zh-Hant.title: 我的昆蟲藝廊
zh-Hant.description:
近距離照片在黑色背景中呈現蜘蛛、毛蟲、蝗蟲、昆蟲卵、白色若蟲與椿象。

攝影｜自然觀察｜照片｜學生作品｜Yu Chun Tsai 設計指導

captions: Locust, insect eggs, white nymph, caterpillar and stinkbugs.
蝗蟲、昆蟲卵、白色若蟲、毛蟲與椿象。

sections.heading: Problem
sections.body: The gallery collects small creatures photographed against a dark background.

zh-Hant.heading: 問題
zh-Hant.body: 這個藝廊收集了在黑色背景中拍下的小生物。

sections.heading: Research
sections.body: Two spiders hang on their threads, and a caterpillar hangs from a single line.

zh-Hant.heading: 研究
zh-Hant.body: 兩隻蜘蛛掛在絲上，一隻毛蟲懸在單一條絲線上。

sections.heading: Development
sections.body: A locust grips a leaf, and insect eggs hang on fine stalks under another leaf.

zh-Hant.heading: 推演
zh-Hant.body: 一隻蝗蟲攀住葉片，昆蟲卵則掛在另一片葉子下方細細的柄上。

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: A white nymph of Lycorma delicatula sits on a rock, and stinkbugs (Pentatomidae) climb a plant beside a caterpillar.

zh-Hant.heading: 成果
zh-Hant.body: 一隻斑衣蠟蟬（Lycorma delicatula）白色若蟲停在岩石上，椿象（Pentatomidae）則與一隻毛蟲一同攀在植物上。

sections.heading: Small Lives - Seen Up Close
sections.body: The photographs isolate each creature against the dark: spiders and a caterpillar on threads, a locust on a leaf, eggs on fine stalks, a white nymph on a rock and stinkbugs on a plant. Each is labelled with its name.

zh-Hant.heading: 微小的生命-近距離觀看
zh-Hant.body: 這些照片把每一隻生物從黑暗中獨立出來：絲上的蜘蛛與毛蟲、葉上的蝗蟲、細柄上的卵、岩石上的白色若蟲，以及植物上的椿象。每張都標上了名稱。
